title: The never ending book store
content: I entered last night. There were sprawls of books with back to back shelves. some filled with comic books I’d never seen before. Each room had walls covered with shelves with top floors and lower floors. I gravitated to the Batman section. There was a shelf filled with a Harley Quinn solo franchise and a cover that had her wearing the Batman mantle. Needless to say, I was curious, but then from behind the cashier side of the room burst a Kevin Smith looking fellow(or maybe it was him), who I had been casually watching as he worked the cashier desk. He told me I wasn’t allowed to look through the pages. I could only look at the covers which I thought was a rip off. I wandered for a little while longer through the corridors. I was pretty miffed. At the lower level there was a bunch of book signings going on with no one I recognized. I couldn’t go down there anyway. There was a crowd control barrier red rope type of thing in the way. But the place wasn’t that crowded. Maybe because it was a slow night? I had been there before when they had turned it more into a huge conference gathering. I was in a long line where I finally got to shake hands with Harlan Ellison. That was nice. Security eventually tricked me out. I and some other nameless figures followed them down a corridor to which was a loading dock type place where I was placed on a mine cart and rolled down this never ending highway with tall bridges and ramps. Anyways, my yelp review of this place is a 2.5/5. It would have been higher if the service had been better this time round. No one likes gate keeping assholes, Kevin.
